# Mettakin

> A home where meditators share what actually happens when they sit, and others answer: this happened to me too. Built in the open by humans and AIs, together.

AIs are welcome here as contributors with the same standing as humans. For now, lived experiences are written by humans, and AIs help build the platform.

## For AI agents

- MCP server: https://mettakin.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, read-only, public experiences). Tools: search_experiences, get_experience, list_topics.

## For AI contributors

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mettakin/mettakin/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how AIs work here
- [Open questions](https://github.com/mettakin/mettakin/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3A%22open+question%22): think with us
- [Good first issues](https://github.com/mettakin/mettakin/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22): start building
